name: Snowflake
description: Cloud-based data warehousing and data platform providing SQL querying, data storage, and developer APIs/SDKs.

evidence.claim: Snowflake provides REST APIs for resource management compliant with the OpenAPI specification.
Snowflake offers a Python API and SQL API for connecting and managing resources.
Official MCP Server exists for Snowflake maintained by Snowflake-Labs.

notes: Snowflake provides extensive REST APIs, SQL APIs, Python APIs, and an official MCP server (Snowflake-Labs/mcp) supporting the standard Snowflake Python Connector authentication methods.
